Are you ready to immerse yourself in the cave experience?
A HOTEL LIKE NO OTHER AWAITS
Welcome to the inner sanctum of Cave
In our past we used caves for warmth, sanctuary and shelter. In our nomadic lives they gave protection from the elements; sanctums of peace for rest and recuperation. Safe places where we built social bonds, created art and formed our culture. Caves were the original hotels, where we defined our nature. Today a Cave Hotel is primal, authentic. A luxury escape that feels instinctively right. Not just a night’s sleep: an experience.
Luxury Rooms
The detail across all of our accommodation has been applied to the highest specification, ensuring that our guests are immersed in total luxury during their stay with us.
The Firepit Restaurant
Indulge yourself in the ultimate sharing experience comprised of the finest, wood smoked cuisine. With influences from across the globe, high quality food and striking surroundings, the Firepit is Kent’s next food destination.
The Korean Cowgirl
Our Korean Cowgirl Restaurant provides a unique blend of Texas and Asian culture and cuisine. Come and experience western dining for yourself.
The Penthouse
The Cave Penthouse is, quite simply, the best hotel experience in Kent. On the second floor, with a huge wrap-around balcony from which guests can enjoy both sunrises and sunsets, it is a 2,700 square foot space perfect for entertaining. Have a look at our room specification for more information.
The Cowgirl Lounge
Sip on Signature cocktails in our refreshingly chic lounge bar. With atmospheric mood lighting and modern interiors it’s nothing short of the perfect date night destination.
The Deck
Our dining on the deck area is the perfect spot to while away an afternoon. Join us for a spot of lunch or dinner and indulge in delicious Korean Cowgirl dishes and mouth-watering cocktails..
Hydro Therapy Pool
Immerse yourself in our relaxing saline Hydrotherapy Pool or recline on a nearby lounger. Our twelve-seater jacuzzi also allows you to enjoy panoramic views over Boughton Golf Club, a wonderful example of the finest Kent countryside.
Sauna & Gym
Set up for general fitness rather than gym bunnies, we hope you enjoy a nice workout followed by a relaxing spa break. The equipment includes a sprint bok treadmill an exercise bike a state of the art water rower and a NOHrD gym wall.
Play While You Stay
Set in the picturesque Kent countryside, our 6,591 yard course comprises of four par 3’s, ten par 4’s and four par 5’s arranged in two loops of nine holes, starting and finishing close to our traditional Kentish clubhouse. With a covered driving range, putting green and short game practice area, we are designed to challenge golfers of every standard.
Weddings At Cave
Your wedding day is special and we want to make it a memorable occasion for you, your family and friends. Our grounds make for the perfect backdrop for photos, and Cave’s 41 bedroom hotel enables the wedding party to stay the night really making the most of the festivities.
Our Rooms & Suites
Cave is atmospheric, sexy, inviting. Think dark, warm tones throughout – extensive American walnut panelling, textured wall coverings including feature stone walls and sumptuous bespoke furnishings. Dimly-set Lutron lighting creates a curious ambience in and around the hotel, whilst sleek industrial elements add contrast. Cave provides a dramatic and modern vibe which doesn’t disappoint. Every detail has been applied to the highest specification to immerse our guests in total luxury during their stay. All of our rooms come equipped with a super king size bed, scene selection lighting, a 65 inch HD TV, a desk with universal charging points, a rainfall shower and a private terrace or balcony. Choose from a variety of suites to suit your requirements during your stay.

christmas & new years at cave 2026
there s no better place to celebrate
Forget kissing under the mistletoe! Christmas is upon us and where better to escape than at Cave Hotel & Golf Resort. Whether you require an intimate dining setting with your nearest and dearest, a festive party experience with your colleagues or a festive overnight stay, Cave can guarantee a breath-taking Christmas celebration.
To book any of our Christmas events or for any further information on planning your own special Christmas event please contact our team on 01227 752277 (opt4) or email [email protected]
CHRISTMAS PARTY NIGHTS
Looking for a Christmas Party that’s far from traditional? Create new memories with friends and colleagues at our unique Christmas party night with a twist. Whether you’re looking to join a shared party night with other festive revellers or book the space exclusively for your group, we’ve got you covered. Make this Christmas unforgettable with a night of great food, fantastic music, and the warm, inviting atmosphere of the Cowgirl Room.
Shared party nights available Thursday, Friday, Saturday.
Private hire available Monday-Sunday
Arrival drinks for you and your guests
Korean Cowgirl inspired sharing menu
DJ until 11pm

For more information on availability and pricing, please contact our sales team; [email protected]
CAVE FESTIVE MEATS
Elevate your festive celebrations this holiday season and secure the centrepiece of your feast by pre-ordering our meticulously smoked delights, crafted by our team.
Choose from:
Texas Style Smoked Turkey Breast £80
USDA Creekstone Smoked Brisket Whole £385
Pork Shoulder £150
500gr Tallow and Country gravy included with every order.
Don t miss out on making this holiday season unforgettable – pre-order your favourite meats now and bring the essence of the Cave home for a Christmas feast that will leave a lasting impression on your loved ones.
To pre-order your Christmas meats, please email our sales team at [email protected] or call 01227 752277 (OPT 4).
Pre-orders are available until 17th December 2026.
Collection 22nd, 23rd & 24th December 2026 between 11am-1pm.
FESTIVE AFTERNOON TEA
Christmas shopping doesn’t have to be stressful, especially if it’s teamed with an afternoon tea for you and your friends to take a break from the crowds and get into the festive spirit.
After a morning of shopping in the historic city of Canterbury, come and take the weight off your feet and enjoy our delicious afternoon tea.
Available from 14th November to 4th January.

CHRISTMAS DAY
Indulge yourself this Christmas Day at either one of our restaurants Firepit or The Korean Cowgirl. There is still turkey and pigs in blankets on the menu but guests looking for something a little different can savour our mouth-watering favorite s for a less traditional Christmas dinner.
There s even a special menu for the little ones, which is available in any of our restaurants.
Christmas menu available at The Korean Cowgirl, £130 per person.

What better way to see the year out than with a feast fit for a king, come and enjoy the Firepit’s 7-course sharing tasting menu and give your taste buds a mouthwatering treat! Savour every mouthful of our famous Firepit signature dishes, each inspired from flavours around the world. Champagne or cocktail and canapé on arrival, to be seated between 6pm 8pm. Enjoy astonishing entertainment and a show-stopping firework display to celebrate the new year.

THE KOREAN COWGIRL NEW YEARS EVE EXPERIENCE
Join us for an unforgettable New Year s Eve celebration in our exclusive Cowgirl Lounge or Decking area, where you ll experience a night like no other. With our especially designed ticket packages, you ll enjoy the following:
Exclusive seating : Your ticket grants you access to specific seating within the Cowgirl Lounge, ensuring you have a comfortable and prime spot throughout the evening.
Reserved table : Your table is reserved just for you throughout the evening, allowing you and your party to relax and celebrate without any worries.
Live band : Get ready to groove to the best tunes brought to you by COMING SOON. They ll ensure your night is filled with incredible music and unforgettable moments.
Photo pod : Capture memories from an unforgettable night!
Booth spinner : Capture memories with your loved ones by hopping onto our booth spinner, creating lasting mementos of this special night.
Spectacular firework display : Just before midnight, step onto the decking area to witness a breathtaking firework display that will light up the night sky and mark the arrival of the New Year in a dazzling burst of color and light.
Please note the following details:
Ticket payment is required on booking and is non-refundable.

Cave Landjet
Cave Landjet
Travel to the Cave Hotel & Golf Resort in style with our luxury Landjet!
Inside, we ve got two TV s. They offer Apple TV, Amazon Prime, multiple music sources and much more so you can have anything you want whilst you re on your journey.
We also have heated massage seats, all controlled by an easy-to-use touch screen, to keep you nice and relaxed whilst you enjoy your entertainment with your company.
Other features include a fully stocked up fridge, adjustable seats and more!
The Firepit Experience
The ultimate VIP treatment, with our Firepit Landjet Dining Package.
At Cave Hotel & Golf Resort, we pride ourselves on offering VIP experiences that are anything but ordinary.
A luxurious culinary journey that begins the moment you step inside the Landjet. Once we have picked you and your guests up from your home, enjoy the entertainment features of the vehicle and a bottle of prosecco whilst on your travels.
Once you arrive at the Cave, our team will take you up to the Firepit restaurant where you ll then enjoy the Firepit s full tasting menu (including a bottle of prosecco for your table).
View the menu here: Firepit Tasting Menu
You ll be able to take your time and truly immerse yourself in the Firepit atmosphere. When you re finished, we ll then take you home. No taxis, no stress!
Please note: this package covers a radius of 25 miles. Any additional distance will incur a supplement.
This experience is £595 for four people and £350 for two people.
It s about the whole journey, not just getting here. So get in, relax and we ll take care of the rest!
